README.description: Example fictional participant information file used to demonstrate the expected structure of the pipeline input metadata.
README.note: All information in this file is fictional and does not correspond to real participants or recordings.

structure.Participants: List containing participant metadata and associated physiological recordings.
structure.Date: Participant birth date or relevant date information.
structure.Pre D1: BITalino device identifier used during the first pre-intervention recording.
structure.Pre D2: BITalino device identifier used during the second pre-intervention recording.
structure.Intervention: BITalino device identifier used during the intervention recording.
structure.Post Intervention: BITalino device identifier used during the post-intervention recording.
structure.Relative Path Pre D1: Relative path to the physiological signal file recorded with the Pre D1 BITalino device.
structure.Relative Path Pre D2: Relative path to the physiological signal file recorded with the Pre D2 BITalino device.
structure.Relative Path Intervention: Relative path to the physiological signal file recorded with the Intervention BITalino device.
structure.Relative Path Post Intervention: Relative path to the physiological signal file recorded with the Post Intervention BITalino device.
